terms: on-road price, ex-showroom price, quotation, EMI, down payment, token amount, booking amount, exchange, RTO, insurance (1+3 or 3+3), extended warranty, accessories, test drive, waiting period, stock, delivery date, scheme, discount

checks.need: done only if the rep established the purpose, who will use or drive the car, and the preferred model, fuel or colour. Knowing only the model is partly.
checks.budget: done only if the REP asked for the budget or EMI. A customer who says a figure unprompted, or haggling over price, is not asking the budget (missed or partly).
checks.decision_timing: done only if the rep asked when and how they will decide or who else decides. A customer mentioning urgency alone is partly.
checks.options: done only if the rep compared more than one suitable model or version and explained the difference. Showing one car or only colours is partly.
checks.experience: done only if a test drive or a showroom or stock visit was offered or arranged. Only describing the car is missed.
checks.value_proof: done only if the rep explained why this car is worth it in terms of the customer's need, with specifics. A list of features is partly.
checks.price_offers: done only if one clear price (on-road or ex-showroom) was given with the offers stated. Shifting or several different figures, or a price without offers, is partly.
checks.concerns: done only if every concern the customer raised was answered specifically. If any concern was answered loosely or not at all, it is partly.
checks.ask: done only if the rep asked the customer to book or pay a token. Quoting a price is not asking.
checks.next_step: done only if a next step with a day or time was agreed. A promise to send details, or a phone number given, without a date is partly.

check_labels.decision_timing: Found out when and how they decide
check_labels.experience: Offered a test drive or showroom visit
check_labels.value_proof: Explained why this car is worth it
check_labels.price_offers: Gave a clear price and offers
check_labels.next_step: Agreed a next step with a date
